name: OSWorld 2.0 task classes
notes: The Hub API at revision 0a1aadad reports gated 'auto' (access is approved automatically after a logged-in request) and 147 files: 108 task_*.py classes, 34 task implementation notes, a task-hash manifest and the card. The card and files sit behind that gate and were not read; the description comes from the OSWorld-V2 README, which links this dataset as its data and downloads it into evaluation_examples/task_class. The README pins task, asset and website snapshots per benchmark release (osworld-v2.1 recommended, plus osworld-v2-2026.08.08 and osworld-v2-2026.06.24), so the main-branch file count is not a release's task count. Task assets are in the separate gated xlangai/osworld_v2_assets_gated dataset and anonymous runtime assets in xlangai/osworld_v2_assets; neither is covered here. The code repository github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld-V2 is not an active record, so no component relation is recorded. The card metadata declares Apache-2.0.
summary: Gated Hub release of the OSWorld 2.0 benchmark's Python task classes, which hold task setup and evaluator logic kept out of the public code to limit leakage and are pinned per benchmark release.
